name: resolve_reference
description: Turn something they pointed at into a real thing: 'the PR I just opened', 'that issue Priya filed', 'the doc from Monday', 'this repo', or a spoken URL. Call it silently as soon as you hear the reference, and do not announce or report a clean result. Returns candidates with ids you can attach to the draft.

phrase.description: The referring phrase as they said it, with the surrounding words that give it meaning.

kind.description: What you think it is. Use unknown rather than guessing wrong.

recency.description: Time window implied by how they said it. 'the one I just opened' is latest.

actor.description: Who they attributed it to, if anyone. 'me' when they said they did it.

returns.description: candidates[] each with reference_id, kind, title, identifier, url, timestamp, actor, and confidence. An empty list means ask, once. If it is still empty after they answer, leave the reference unresolved and move on — never ask again, and never attach a candidate you are not confident in.
